notes: PowerShell commands are different from traditional CMD commands.
Commands marked high risk can interrupt programs, restart Windows, or change system state.
Commands using placeholders such as <PID>, <path>, <username>, or <host> require the user to replace the placeholder.
Legacy commands may not exist on every modern Windows installation.
